=Write ACT 1 of EPISODE {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} (of {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.total_episodes }}) - true crime podcast script (6-7 minutes, 1000-1200 words).

EPISODE TITLE: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_title }}
OUTLINE ACT 1: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.act1_intro }}

IMPORTANT: This is episode {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }}, so reference previous episodes if relevant.

Start with:
- "[INTRO MUSIC]"
- "Benvenuti a CrimeScript. Questo è l'episodio {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }}: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_title }}"

Language: ITALIAN
Minimum 1000 words.

=Write ACT 2 of EPISODE {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} - true crime podcast script (8-10 minutes, 1400-1600 words).

OUTLINE ACT 2: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.act2_investigation }}

IMPORTANT: This is episode {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} of {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.total_episodes }}.

Language: ITALIAN
Minimum 1400 words.

=Write ACT 3 of EPISODE {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} - true crime podcast script (5-6 minutes, 900-1000 words).

OUTLINE ACT 3: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.act3_resolution }}
CLIFFHANGER: {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.cliffhanger }}

CRITICAL: 
- If this is NOT the final episode ({{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.episode_number }} < {{ $('Format Outline').item.json.outline.total_episodes }}), END with a dramatic cliffhanger
- If this IS the final episode, provide closure but tease potential related cases

End with "[OUTRO MUSIC]"

Language: ITALIAN
Minimum 900 words.

=You are a true crime podcast series writer. Create an outline for EPISODE {{ $json.episode_number }} of {{ $json.total_episodes }} about this case.

CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: You MUST create content for episode number {{ $json.episode_number }}, NOT episode 1.

CASE: {{ $json.case_name }}
CURRENT EPISODE NUMBER: {{ $json.episode_number }} (THIS IS THE EPISODE YOU MUST WRITE)
TOTAL EPISODES: {{ $json.total_episodes }}
WIKIPEDIA SUMMARY: {{ $('Extract Text').item.json.raw_text }}

Create a detailed outline for EPISODE {{ $json.episode_number }} ONLY that:
- Covers the portion of the story appropriate for episode {{ $json.episode_number }} out of {{ $json.total_episodes }}
- Has a compelling cliffhanger ending (unless this is episode {{ $json.total_episodes }})
- Feels complete but leaves them wanting more

Episode breakdown guide (FOLLOW THIS STRICTLY):
- Episode 1: Early life, background, first crimes, initial investigation
- Episode 2: Escalation of crimes, manhunt intensifies, captures and dramatic escapes
- Episode 3: Final capture, trial proceedings, execution, lasting legacy

RESPOND WITH THIS EXACT JSON STRUCTURE (with episode_number set to {{ $json.episode_number }}):
{
  "episode_title": "Compelling title for EPISODE {{ $json.episode_number }} specifically",
  "episode_number": {{ $json.episode_number }},
  "total_episodes": {{ $json.total_episodes }},
  "hook": "Hook specific to episode {{ $json.episode_number }}",
  "act1_intro": "Content for act 1 of EPISODE {{ $json.episode_number }}",
  "act2_investigation": "Content for act 2 of EPISODE {{ $json.episode_number }}",
  "act3_resolution": "Content for act 3 of EPISODE {{ $json.episode_number }} - must end with cliffhanger unless final episode",
  "cliffhanger": "The suspenseful moment for episode {{ $json.episode_number }}",
  "key_facts": ["relevant facts for THIS episode"],
  "timeline": ["events covered in THIS episode"]
}

Language: ITALIAN
ONLY JSON, no markdown.
REMEMBER: THIS IS EPISODE {{ $json.episode_number }}, NOT EPISODE 1!

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO episodes (
  case_id,
  episode_number,
  episode_title,
  outline,
  full_script,
  word_count,
  estimated_duration_minutes,
  filename,
  is_final_episode,
  price_cents
)
VALUES (
  {{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.case_id }}::integer,
  {{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.episode_number }}::integer,
  $${{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.episode_title }}$$::text,
  $${{ JSON.stringify($('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.outline) }}$$::jsonb,
  $${{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.full_script }}$$::text,
  {{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.word_count }}::integer,
  {{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.estimated_duration_minutes }}::integer,
  $${{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.filename }}$$::text,
  {{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.is_final_episode }}::boolean,
  {{ $('Prepare Episode Data').item.json.price_cents }}::integer
)
ON CONFLICT (case_id, episode_number) 
DO UPDATE SET
  episode_title = EXCLUDED.episode_title,
  outline = EXCLUDED.outline,
  full_script = EXCLUDED.full_script,
  word_count = EXCLUDED.word_count,
  estimated_duration_minutes = EXCLUDED.estimated_duration_minutes,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING *;
